Swiss Army Bench 0.0.28

- **An update always shows its own screens.** The desktop app kept the previous version's page files in its cache,
  so after updating to 0.0.27 some screens still looked like 0.0.26 (the `{x}` insert-variable buttons, for one).
  The app now clears those saved files once whenever its version changes, and checks each page file before reusing
  it. Your sign-in, layout and other saved settings are kept.
